description: Generate an image from a text prompt. Returns a permanent public URL. Synchronous, usually 2-20 seconds, a few cents. Corent picks the model; a model the user names in the prompt is used. Set quality "best" only when the user asks for the best quality, and max_cost_cents when they give a budget. reference_image_urls keeps a face, character or product consistent.

enhance_prompt.description: Corent rewrites the prompt before dispatch to get a better render. Pass false when the user has carefully worded their own prompt and wants it sent verbatim.

height.description: Explicit pixel height; pass with width.

max_cost_cents.description: The most this may cost, in cents. Set it when the user gives a budget or a price limit. Refused before anything is spent when no model fits under it, and never exceeded.

model.description: Pin an exact model by name, e.g. "corent-flux-schnell" (list_models shows the menu; every name there is spelled corent-*). Never substituted, flat cost-plus price; max_cost_cents still applies. Only for a user who insists on one exact model; otherwise leave it out and let Corent choose.

n.description: How many versions to render, 1 to 10. Each is a REAL render at the normal price, so n=4 costs four images; confirm with the user before spending on more than a couple. They come back together and meta.cost_cents is the total.

negative_prompt.description: What must NOT appear, e.g. "text, watermark".

prompt.description: What to generate, in plain language. If the user names a model ("use seedance 2.5", "made with Veo 3.1 Fast"), leave that in the prompt: Corent uses that model when it can do the job, removes those words before rendering, and the receipt says so.

quality.description: Set "best" only when the user asks for the best or highest quality: Corent then uses its top model for the job, which costs more. Leave it out otherwise and Corent picks the model. Has no effect when `model` pins one.

reference_image_urls.description: 1 to 16 public https image URLs that keep a CHARACTER, FACE, or PRODUCT consistent across generations. The prompt is applied as an EDIT of these references, so use it whenever the user wants the same person/object again in a new scene, a product placed somewhere, or a series that has to match. Corent sends it only to a model that can edit; each model takes its own number (list_models: max_reference_images). Omit entirely for plain text-to-image.

seed.description: Reproducibility. The same seed with the same prompt and model gives the same image, so use it to re-render a picture the user liked and change one thing. The seed that was used comes back in meta.seed even when you did not pass one.

source_image_url.description: Image-to-image: start from this picture rather than from scratch. Pair with `strength`. Different from reference_image_urls, which pins an identity across scenes.

strength.description: How far to travel from source_image_url. 0 keeps it, 1 ignores it.

transparent.description: Transparent background, for logos and product cutouts. Forces png.

width.description: Explicit pixel width; pass with height.
